power.neoorigins.wraith_hunger_drain.des: Ilaalinta jirkaaga muuqaalku waa cashuur - waxaad daalinaysaa gaajada 75% ka dhakhso badan sidii caadiga ahayd.

power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_dayligh: Dareenka iftiinka Qorraxda oo sii yaraanaya
Iftiinka qorraxdu wali wuu gubanayaa, laakiin kala badh xoogga.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.name: Foomka Spectral (Apex)

origins.neoorigins.skeleton.name: Qalfoofka
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.description: Shandad lafo ah oo dib loo nooleeyay - dhakhso badan, iftiin leh, oo qaanso leh oo dilaa ah.Jidh jilicsan, oo ay cadceeddu ka fogaato, oo kaliya oo awood u leh in uu caloosha u qaado qashinka ugu xun.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.name: Aan dhiman
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.descrip: Adigu ma dhimanDaawaynta daawaynta ayaa ku dhaawacaysa, Waxyeelaynta dawooyinka ayaa ku bogsiisay, iyo sixir bararka ayaa dhaawac dheeraad ah kuu geysata.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_water_breathin: Uma baahna inuu neefsado.Wuxuu ku noolaan karaa ilaa xad aan xad lahayn.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_marksmanship.d: +2 waxyeello gunno ah oo leh hub saafi ah.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.name: Iftiinka Lafaha
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.descript: Lafahaaga godan ayaa 20% kaa dhigaya inaad cagahaaga ku degdegto.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_jump.name: Fudud
power.neoorigins.skeleton_jump.descripti: Ka bood 30% ka sarreeya inta caadiga ah.
Lafahaaga jilicsan ayaa caafimaadkaaga ugu badan ka dhigaya 7 qalbi.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_daylight_damag: Waxaad ku gubtaa iftiinka qorraxda si toos ah ilaa koofiyadda.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.name: Cunto Lafo La'aan ah
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.descripti: Waxaad cuni kartaa oo kaliya cunto lafaha, hilib qudhuntay, iyo indhaha caarada.
Cuntada lafaha adigaa la cuni karaa.
origins.neoorigins.slime.name: Caato
origins.neoorigins.slime.description: Neef jelatin ah oo ay tahay in uu fuuqbaxo si uu u noolaado.Si aan dhib lahayn ayuu uga soo dhacaa, wuu kala go'aa dhimashada marka uu si fiican u qoyan yahay, oo wuu sii adkaadaa isagoo khibrad leh.
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.name: Qoyaanka
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.descript: Waxaad haysataa baarka qoyaanka oo qulqulaya waqti ka dib.Si degdeg ah ayuu uga daadanayaa saxaraha iyo marka uu dabka kaco.Istaag biyaha ama roobka si aad u fuuqbaxdo.Ka sarreeya 75%: Regen 1. Ka hooseeya 10%: -4 hub.Markay tahay 0%: waxaad qaadanaysaa dhaawac
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.name: Qaybi
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.descri: Markaad ku dhimato qoyaan ka badan 75%, waxaad kala qaybsantay beddelkeeda - teleporting 50 blocks oo leh 2 qalbi.HP-ga ugu badan ayaa dib u soo cusboonaada 2 daqiiqo ka dib.
